title: Melt more ice
hook: Change mass changing phase and predict heat needed for the phase change.

knows: heat needed for the phase change

misconception: heat needed for the phase change stays fixed when mass changing phase doubles.
objective: Apply Q = mL to compare heat needed for the phase change when mass changing phase changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With fixed latent heat with the material at its phase-change temperature, Q = mL. When mass changing phase doubles, heat needed for the phase change becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = mL; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider fixed latent heat with the material at its phase-change temperature, with a nonzero initial result. If mass changing phase triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on heat needed for the phase change?
recall.why: Apply Q = mL under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
